context: An elderly couple plans home repairs and family visits
purpose: Teach: ぢ/四つ/十一月/建てる/身内/本名/瀬/山中

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 十一月に、息子の家族が来るって。
lines.en: Our son's family is visiting in November.
lines.style: Gentle, accepting tone. Quiet observation held without weight. Pause mid-thought as if turning the fact over. No rush—this is how he sits with what's coming.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: うん。本名で呼ばずに、相変わらず「ヒロちゃん」って呼ばれるのね。
lines.en: Mm. Even after all this time, they still call you "Hiro-chan" instead of your real name.
lines.style: Amused, affectionate undercurrent. Knowing glance sideways. Light tease wrapped in tenderness—she's been watching this for years. Soft on the nickname.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 四つ家、増築するか、迷ってる。
lines.en: I'm still deciding whether to add more rooms to the house.
lines.style: Hesitant, turning a problem around in his hands aloud. Quiet irony—practical needs meeting old reluctance. Slight exhale of uncertainty. Not seeking answers, just naming it.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 今のままで建てるなら、業者さんに頼みましょう。
lines.en: If you decide to build now, we should call a contractor.
lines.style: Practical and direct, but with encouragement underneath. Matter-of-fact warmth—the tone of someone who knows how to make a decision and has watched him circle one for years. Gentle push forward.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: 山中湖の別荘、夏は身内が泊まりに来るかな。
lines.en: The villa at Lake Yamanaka—I wonder if the family will come stay there in summer.
lines.style: Soft, hopeful. Trailing off slightly as if imagining. The voice of someone picturing grandchildren in a place he loves. Gentle speculation, not quite asking a question.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: 川の瀬の音、孫が喜ぶわよ。
lines.en: The grandchildren will love the sound of the river there.
lines.style: Certain, tender, with the warmth of memory. She knows this will matter. Slight brightness on "grandkids"—she delights in this small certainty. Voice settles on it like a gift already given.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_elder
lines.jp: お尻のぢ、また気になるんだ、最近。
lines.en: It's been bothering me again lately—my hemorrhoids.
lines.style: Dry, matter-of-fact admission without self-pity. Wry acceptance of the body's small indignities. Voice is flat on the complaint itself, almost conversational—this is aging, nothing more or less.

lines.speaker: sachiko_grandma
lines.jp: お医者に診てもらってね。
lines.en: You should have a doctor look at it.
lines.style: Practical, warm instruction delivered with the ease of long marriage. Not worried—just the voice of someone who says what needs saying and trusts he'll listen. Closing thought, settled and final.
